title: Daily goals 2026-11-20: kickstart run 2 (#1541 trial)
body:
## Daily goals — 2026-11-20 kickstart run 2 (the #1541 trial)

Operator-authorized outcome: run 2 of arc #1541 (operator approval OA-1, 2026-11-20T06:48Z; scope chosen by the operator 2026-11-20 ~16:50Z). It measures acceptance checks KS-16, KS-17, KS-18 and KS-20 while it works this scope. The child is Claude Sonnet 5.5 (high effort), which has no 600-second command ceiling, so KS-07's proof can be recorded in this run.

Selected scope (existing work only):
- [ ] #1417 — canonical attempt accounting before task qualification (run-1 item 5b)
- [ ] #1467 — relay-drive runs the reviewer gate itself (run-1 item 5b)
- [ ] #1471 — xyz-vendor --ledger-only tier (run-1 item 5b)
- [ ] #1497 — no false dependency.drift for absent surfaces (run-1 item 5b)
- [ ] #1500 — intake.py copies untracked .pyc files (run-1 item 9b)
- [ ] #1530 — express.py appends CHANGELOG.md regardless of CHANGELOG_WRITES
- [ ] #1551 — KS-07: host-native background execution for long operations; record the >600s native background check on this host against branch `feat/XYZ-forge-gh1551-ks07-bg-long-ops-2026-11-20` (c34e8986b5), then finish through final QA

Run-1 park reasons still apply and must be resolved, not bypassed: the 5b PRs need one recorded batch with `--landing-plan` and a reason, per-key ledger resolution, and verified code-level interactions (#1417 vs #1526, #1471 vs #1501, #1467 vs #1507). #1500 changes the intake digest; if that needs an operator decision, record it as a decision (KS-11), not an intervention.

Budgets: wall deadline 2026-11-21T06:00Z; at most 2 attempts per item, then park and advance. Authority is the KS-03 Authority block printed into the run record by `build_queue.py --daily-goals`; nothing here widens it. Out of scope: #1400, #1418, #1480–#1483, #1537 (KS-12), KS-19, deploys and installed-skill updates.

Acceptance (frozen before the run, per KS-18): zero interventions and zero supervision actions in run 1's classes. Report merges, interventions, operator decisions, elapsed time, gate minutes, parent turns and manual resumes. KS-16 (injected duplicate completion) and KS-20 (deliberate parent interruption) are exercised by the parent during the run.
